simplest_alternative.description: How the whole task could be done with materially fewer moving parts; empty when the change is already near that.

prior_id.description: The fix this finding follows up; empty otherwise.

title.description: One line: the visible effect, not the mechanism.

failure_scenario.description: Inputs and state that give the wrong result; for complexity, what a reader must hold that they need not.

impact.description: If nobody fixes it: who or what sees the failure, how often, how bad. For complexity, what it costs the next reader or change.

fix.description: The concrete change; for complexity, the simpler version.

fix_sketch.description: A minimal unified diff of the fix, at most 20 lines; empty when the fix is longer.

changes_behavior.description: Callers see different behaviour after the fix.
